unit.note: 1 u = 1/2000 of the wall width, in 4789 px

normal.encoding: R = nx*0.5+0.5, G = ny*0.5+0.5 (image space, y down; flip G for GL y up), B = relief height 0..1; lossy WebP, renormalise in the shader

id.R: bib index 1..N = position in bibs[] + 1; 0 = no bib (wall, floor, gaps)
id.G: inside distance to the bib's own outline: G = round(min(d, 16 u) * 8), so d = G / 8 u, saturated at 128 (16 u); taxicab metric on the 1200 px grid; the photo frame is not an outline; 0 outside
id.B: anchor proximity: 255 * (1 - min(d / 88 u, 1)) in 32 steps of 8, d = taxicab distance to the nearest held edge or pin of the same bib; mesh weight w = smoothstep(0, 1, 1 - B/255); 0 outside or when a bib has no held edge and no pin
id.metric: taxicab (L1) distances keep the PNG small; they read up to 1.41x longer than Euclidean on diagonals

fields.poly: visible region, disjoint (overlaps resolved by stacking, inset 1.5 px), integer px, edge i = poly[i] -> poly[i+1]
fields.quad: full-sheet estimate TL, TR, BR, BL (may leave the photo); crop rectangle corners map exactly onto it
fields.held: edge indices covered by a neighbour on top or cut by the photo frame (automatic, id raster)
fields.pins: observed pin holes (pinSource 'observed'), else visible quad corners inset 4 % ('quad-corners-4%'), else none
fields.z: global stacking rank 0..N-1 (topological sort of covers; cycles broken as listed in meta.zIgnored, pairwise geometry keeps every statement)
fields.readingOrder: 1..N, four horizontal bands top to bottom, left to right inside a band
fields.obb: box of the visible polygon in the sheet's frame; angle = sheet rotation in degrees (TL->TR, image y down, CSS rotate sign)
fields.halo: hit halo for fragments narrower than 44 CSS px on a 360 px phone (wall at 280vw); overlaps neighbours, draw after the polygons
fields.anchor: most interior point of the visible polygon (label / focus / pan target)
fields.neighbours: arrow-key targets: nearest anchor inside a ~50 deg cone, sideways distance x1.5; null at the wall's edge
fields.covers: mapping statements: bibs this sheet lies on (pairwise, may be cyclic)
